findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:665-670 [HIGH] Protected direct candidates are still sliced by candidateBudget. routeCandidateSpecs assigns related-doc/exact-path/registry-ref/typed-risk/reviewer-evidence score 100, then ranked.slice(0, candidateBudget) drops every protected source beyond the first N. CHK-002 promises that each protected source remains selected even above the frequency threshold; a story with more than eight explicit sources can silently omit required documents. Preserve all protected candidates (or fail/escalate when they exceed the budget) and add an over-budget protected-source test.
findings.resolvedReason: Mandatory protected candidates are selected ahead of the ordinary budget; focused routing smoke proves they survive candidateBudget truncation.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:183-192 [MEDIUM] Post-probe readiness drift is not classified as promised. If a previously ready launcher reaches the real run and then prints auth/interactive failure to stderr and exits nonzero, defaultHostRunRunner retains no stderr and productionExecutor returns only generic host unavailable exit 1; only silent startup timeout gets a distinct reason. CHK-001 edge:2 explicitly requires a distinct stale-readiness/auth/interactive/no-output diagnostic. Preserve bounded failure diagnostics or map host-run failure evidence, and test injected post-admission auth/interactive exits without real hosts.
findings.resolvedReason: Post-readiness failures now retain bounded stderr and emit stable auth, interactive, no-output, or spawn diagnostics; host-run smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:476 CHK-001 mandatory matrix is not covered: the test exercises only unverified/unsupported/auth/timeout, while the intent requires every non-ready state to prove zero spawn (missing row, wrong_launcher, launcherOk=false, progressMode=none/unobservable, silent output/other canonical failures). packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts:2760 tests startup and total timeout directly, but only abort goes through runHostRun and proves cap=1 reacquisition; there is no deterministic first-byte boundary table or output/timeout/close/error/abort ordering matrix. Most importantly packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:270 snapshots readiness once before proposal execution, and no test simulates readiness becoming stale between probe and spawn or verifies the promised distinct stale-readiness/auth/interactive diagnostic. The broad PASS evidence therefore does not substantiate multiple must intents.
findings.resolvedReason: Focused host matrix now covers canonical non-ready states, startup/total/abort cleanup, first-byte boundaries, close/error races, and immediate slot reacquisition; 81 host checks and 10 readiness checks pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:261 does not test the CHK-002 adversarial generic-only flood: it injects five 100-point protectedSources, so the route never faces only lattice/proofbound/core/handlers. With only those over-frequency terms, they are all filtered, ranked is empty, and packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:634-653 emits zero_candidates escalation, contradicting the mandatory intent that generic-only flood cannot cause ambiguity escalation. Add an actual generic-only corpus/proposal case and align the intended zero-candidate disposition before claiming this intent PASS.
findings.resolvedReason: Generic-only filtered vocabulary no longer synthesizes zero_candidates or full-scan escalation without an independent reason; focused routing smoke passes.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:245-317 covers one above-threshold example, one safe truncation example, only NaN malformed evidence, and renderer strings. It does not cover the required exact DF boundary (at threshold vs just above), duplicate occurrences counting once per document, omitted-score/cutoff missing or inconsistent combinations, cutoff equality, or gate-level shadow/warn/enforce dispositions. The assertion at line 317 compares artifactDigest to itself and cannot detect mode-induced artifact disagreement. Add a table-driven matrix for these stated must cases and exercise the actual binding/gate consumer for each mode.
findings.resolvedReason: Routing smoke now covers exact DF boundary and deduplication, malformed/non-finite truncation evidence, independent digest verification, and shadow/warn/enforce disposition.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:214-217 — HIGH: currentStoryRoutingInput promotes both filesReadFully and filesTriagedByName from every valid reviewer manifest into reviewer-evidence protectedSources. filesTriagedByName is explicitly the non-selected remainder of the requirements corpus, not reviewer-selected evidence; after one bounded review it can therefore promote nearly the whole corpus at 100 points on the next route, recreating the candidate inflation/full-scan cost this story is meant to remove and crowding out genuinely selected evidence under the 8-item budget. Only positively selected/read evidence should be protected; filename/title triage must remain audit evidence, not direct-candidate authority.
findings.resolvedReason: Only current signed filesReadFully evidence is promoted; filesTriagedByName is excluded from protected reviewer evidence.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:552-555,665-670 — HIGH: the new typed protected-source contract is not actually fail-closed. Any explicit path/registry/reviewer source absent from the requirements-only corpus is silently skipped, and every remaining protected source is mixed into ordinary ranking then truncated by ranked.slice(0, candidateBudget). Thus a changed source path such as packages/main/src/core/process-fact-registry.ts is discarded outright, while nine configured relatedDocs or protected sources silently lose at least one despite the acceptance promise that exact paths and all relatedDocs remain candidates. Protected authorities need explicit existence/normalization handling plus a deterministic overflow/escalation rule, and tests must exceed the budget and include a non-requirements exact/registry path.
findings.resolvedReason: Existing repo-relative mandatory sources outside the requirements corpus are hashed and retained; missing or unsafe sources produce typed diagnostics; protected candidates are not ordinary-budget sliced.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:241-244,292-294 and packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:741-743 [HIGH] Mode consistency is only fixed in renderCandidateSpecRouteText. PLAN/REVIEW dispatch still emits unconditional STOP for an unresolved artifact in shadow or warn, and candidateReadBindingErrors rejects that artifact whenever the encouraged optional digest is supplied, regardless of mode. Because prompts explicitly require the digest, configured shadow/warn can still behave as enforce and force the broad scan this story is meant to prevent. Thread routing mode through dispatch and blocking predicates; shadow records, warn advises, enforce alone blocks, with end-to-end dispatch/gate tests.
findings.resolvedReason: Signed routing mode is consumed end-to-end: shadow observes, warn advises without hard block, enforce alone blocks; candidate and reason computation stays identical.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:261-279 proves five protected kinds only by manually injecting synthetic protectedSources into the core router; it never exercises currentStoryRoutingInput. In the real handler, packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:221-233 converts Story riskSignals to category:matched and promotes typed-risk only when matched looks like a path. Normal typed risk records such as this Story Security/Credentials:auth and Production/Emergency:production therefore produce no typed-risk protected candidate at all. There is likewise no handler-level test proving signed/current reviewer evidence is admitted while stale/unbound evidence is excluded. The claimed five-class end-to-end contract is not covered and the typed-risk class is unreachable for ordinary detector output.
findings.resolvedReason: Real handler integration now derives authority only from structured risk signals, explicit docs and paths, and current signed full-read reviewer evidence; stale or unbound evidence is rejected.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1204-1215 — MEDIUM: normal Node spawn failures are mislabeled child_error, because spawn(2) failures such as ENOENT are delivered through ChildProcess error rather than the synchronous catch. Deterministic repro against /definitely/missing/b3aec-host returned terminalReason=child_error and exitCode=-2, while the new result contract exposes spawn_error and production diagnostics therefore degrade to generic host unavailable exit -2. Preserve the error object and classify pre-spawn/ENOENT failures as spawn_error (with a stable diagnostic), while still settling on close for reap discipline.
findings.resolvedReason: Async ENOENT and EACCES spawn errors normalize to terminalReason spawn_error, exit 1, stable missing_executable classification, exactly-once settlement and cleanup.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:252-274 — MEDIUM: the new B-3aec implementation contract presents unresolved acceptance behavior as delivered. In current code, protected/direct sources can be silently skipped or truncated by candidateBudget (already captured by F-001/F-007), generic-only filtered terms can still yield zero_candidates escalation (F-004), and shadow/warn dispatch and candidateReadBindingErrors still apply enforce-style STOP/blocking (F-008). Therefore lines 266-274 falsely promise authoritative direct candidates and mode-only presentation/blocking, while lines 237-242 state acceptance already contradicted by the implementation. Either fix those underlying behaviors so the contract becomes true, or mark the section as intended/pending and explicitly list the limitations; do not retain an unqualified implemented-contract claim.
findings.resolvedReason: Execution-plan section 7.7 now describes only the bounded implemented contract and its explicit limits, aligned with focused evidence.

findings.desc: docs/requirements/decisions/workflow-convergence-failure-remediation-execution-plan.md:276-279 — HIGH: the revised implemented-contract still overstates mode consistency. It says renderer, reviewer dispatch, and read-binding consumers detect mode disagreement while only enforce hard-rejects, but packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:104 throws on every configured/artifact mode mismatch including shadow and warn; packages/main/src/handlers/story-dispatch.ts:549-555 retains an unconditional STOP for item-scoped reviewer dispatch whenever escalation is unresolved, without consulting routing mode; and packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:792-801 returns immediately for shadow/warn, so the read-binding consumer does not detect disagreement there at all. This leaves the documented shadow-records/warn-advises behavior false and can still stop bounded review outside enforce. Route item dispatch through the shared mode-aware guidance and make mismatch disposition match the documented contract (or narrow the document truthfully), with focused tests for all three modes.
findings.resolvedReason: Mode mismatch is now diagnosed in all modes; renderer and story/item dispatch observe in shadow, advise in warn, and hard reject only in enforce; docs and focused tests align.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:478-545 still applies queryGroupBudget before document-frequency filtering. Ten high-frequency seed terms can consume all ten groups, be filtered away, and starve an eleventh specific term that uniquely matches a required document. Deterministic reproduction with 5 temp docs yielded groups=[], candidates=[], ambiguity=[generic_only_filtered_bounded], requiresEscalation=false even though rareneedle matched one document. This violates CHK-002 edge:2 (generic+specific mixture preserves specific identifiers) and can silently omit the exact document without escalation. Filter/rank terms before the group budget or refill vacated generic slots, and add a >budget mixed-order/permutation test.
findings.resolvedReason: All ordered query terms are document-frequency filtered before queryGroupBudget; deterministic over-budget generic starvation repro preserves the later rare candidate and audit metrics.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1209-1230 retains bounded stderr for post-readiness classification, but stdout is represented only by UsageLineScanner.retainedText(). A child that emits `authentication required: please login` on stdout produces firstOutputMs, exit_nonzero, failureKind=unknown, stdout= and therefore loses the required distinct auth diagnostic. Current tests at packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts:2844 exercise auth/interactive only on stderr, so CHK-001 happy:0/edge:2 are not closed for the promised stdout-or-stderr behavior. Retain bounded diagnostic stdout separately and test both streams.
findings.resolvedReason: Host failure classification consumes both stdout and stderr incrementally through a bounded sticky classifier; stdout-only auth and interactive cases pass.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/host-run-usage-smoke.ts:2760-2890 still has no deterministic ordering matrix for first-output/timeout/close/error/abort. The new cases separately cover ENOENT, stderr classification, two timeouts, and abort, but do not force or assert every race ordering, kill-once, listener/timer cleanup, or release-once as required by CHK-001 adversarial:3; existing unrelated slot reclaim races do not exercise the new runner settlement state. F-003 is therefore only partially closed. Add an injected fake child/timer seam or equivalent deterministic scheduler that enumerates the terminal event orderings and counts settle/kill/release.
findings.resolvedReason: Minimal deterministic child/timer seam covers output-startup, timeout-close, error-close, and abort-output-close races with settle once, kill at most once, listener and timer cleanup, release once and immediate reacquire.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/candidate-spec-routing-smoke.ts:160-172 now explicitly asserts that ordinary structured typed risks such as Security/Credentials:auth and Production/Emergency:production produce no typed-risk protected candidate. packages/main/src/handlers/candidate-spec-routing.ts:240-252 only creates typed-risk candidates when matched text already looks like a path. That codifies rather than closes F-009 and contradicts CHK-002 happy:1/adversarial:1, which require typed risk-signal sources among protected direct candidates. The reviewer-evidence checks also test currentReviewerFullyReadPaths with handcrafted valid/invalid arrays, not real signed/current versus stale collector integration through currentStoryRoutingInput. Either revise the accepted intent explicitly or provide authoritative risk-to-source mapping and handler-level signed evidence tests.
findings.resolvedReason: Real handler integration now uses structured exact canonical risk paths or typed broader-scan without fake paths; real signed current review-run/pass collector protects full reads, excludes triage, and rejects committed stale drift.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/candidate-spec-routing.ts:679-688 — HIGH: mandatory protected candidates are retained, but ambiguity/cutoff escalation is still computed over the combined ranked list. A deterministic route with 10 exact-path protected sources, candidateBudget=8, and zero ordinary candidates returns all 10 candidates yet requiresEscalation=true with candidate_cutoff_tie and weak_source_class_coverage. Because the ordinary budget is explicitly separate from protectedRouting, mandatory-source count/ties and a single authoritative protected kind must not manufacture a full-corpus escalation; compute cutoff/tie over ordinaryRanked and exempt authoritative protected-only routing from weak-source ambiguity (while preserving missing/unsafe protected-source escalation).
findings.resolvedReason: Cutoff, tie, and weak-source logic now use ordinary candidates only; 10 protected candidates with budget 8 and zero ordinary candidates do not falsely escalate, while missing mandatory sources remain typed.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts:1210-1233 — MEDIUM: bounded stderr classification keeps only the last 64 KiB, then classifies auth/interactive only at close from that retained tail. A child that emits `authentication required: please login` first, flushes more than 64 KiB of later stderr, and exits 1 deterministically returns failureKind=unknown because the decisive early line was sliced away. This is distinct from F-014 (stdout is not retained): stderr is retained, but its tail-only policy still loses an earlier stable failure classification and violates the promised post-readiness auth/interactive diagnostic. Classify bounded chunks incrementally into a sticky typed failure state (without retaining unbounded text), define precedence, and add early-auth/interactive-plus-large-tail tests.
